description: Check whether a domain is set up to send and receive email: MX records, SPF, DMARC, the detected mail provider, and a graded report with a recommendation. Reads public DNS only. Works with no account and no API key, so use it freely to diagnose a domain before suggesting anyone sign up.

domain.description: Domain to check, e.g. example.com. A full URL or an email address is accepted and reduced to its hostname.

name: check_domain_setup
